summary: The statement and proof are correct under the explicit P14.2 all-point upper-semicontinuity assumption. The proof separately establishes equality at the trivial semivaluation using the endpoint identity and the standard endpoint formula for decreasing DXZ infima, establishes equality at every positive rational divisorial point via the decreasing-infimum formula, and therefore has equality on all of Xdivis before invoking dominated divisorial comparison. Divisorial inversion gives uniqueness and model-net independence; order reflection together with MP divisorial comparison gives the claimed pointwise order equivalence. The scope remark correctly leaves open only the converse assertion that every DXZ raw transform is MP-psh.
